title: gaz catches the back line
lines: In The Little Raid, gaz's ability, I heard you weren't graiding., now picks the enemy who has taken the least damage so far, and of those the one who has dealt the least. It no longer picks a front line that is taking the hits.
It stuns them for 2 seconds, then deals 550 magic damage to them and to every enemy touching them (950 at 2 stars, 2200 at 3). gaz starts a fight with 50 mana and his ability takes 80.
